examples.arabic: وقفنا ختيار بشوش قاعد قدام دكانه وسالناه عن زقاق البهارات المعروف
examples.english: We stopped a smiling old man sitting in front of his shop and asked him about the famous spice alley.
examples.transliteration: waafna khtyar bashoush aaed eddam dekkano w saalnah an zuqaq al bharat al maarouf
examples.storyTitle: Getting Lost in the Old Markets

examples.arabic: سأل أبو شادي، الخباز الختيار: "مرحبا، كيفك؟ بدي منقوشة زعتر هلق لو سمحت، بقديش؟"
examples.english: He asked Abu Shadi, the old baker: "Hello, how are you? I want a zaatar manakish now please, how much is it?"
examples.transliteration: sa'al abu shadi, el-khabbaz el-khetyar: "marhaba, kifak? biddi manqoushet zaatar hallaq law samaht, biqaddesh?"

examples.arabic: "مناقيش اللحمة غالية هلق، بس عنا مناقيش زعتر رخيصة"، جاوبو أبو فادي، صاحب المحل الختيار.
examples.english: "Meat manakish are expensive now, but we have cheap zaatar manakish," Abu Fadi, the old shop owner, answered him.
examples.transliteration: "Manaqish al-lahmeh ghaliyeh hallaq, bas 'anna manaqish za'tar rakhisah," jawabo Abu Fadi, sahib al-mahal al-khtyar.

examples.arabic: بعدين شفت ختيار وسألته ودلني على الطريق بوضوح
examples.english: Then I saw an old man and asked him, and he showed me the way clearly.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dēn sheft khtiyār w sa'alto w dallani 3aṭ-ṭarīq bwuḍūḥ.
